items.title: Bitcoin, ether decline as Coldcard exploit enters a fifth day
items.author: Shaurya Malwa

metadata.title_en: Bitcoin, Ether Decline as Coldcard Exploit Enters Fifth Day
metadata.detailed_summary_en: Bitcoin and ether prices have declined as an exploit targeting Coldcard hardware wallets continues for a fifth day. As of August 3, 2026, the security incident remains unresolved, coinciding with a drop in the two largest cryptocurrencies. This situation matters because hardware wallets like Coldcard are widely considered the most secure way to store cryptocurrency, so a prolonged exploit undermines user trust. The associated market decline shows how security incidents can ripple into broader crypto market sentiment. Coldcard is a Bitcoin-only hardware wallet produced by Coinkite since 2017, storing private keys in a dedicated security chip. Specific technical details of the ongoing exploit have not been disclosed in the available material, but hardware wallets can be compromised through supply-chain tampering, malicious firmware, phishing, or physical extraction.
metadata.background_en: Hardware wallets are physical devices that keep cryptocurrency private keys offline to protect against remote hacks. Coldcard emphasizes verifiable source code and features like encrypted microSD backups, making it popular among Bitcoin enthusiasts. An exploit that persists for multiple days is rare and concerning because these devices are designed to minimize attack surface.
metadata.title_zh: 比特币和以太坊下跌，Coldcard 漏洞攻击进入第五天
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 随着针对 Coldcard 硬件钱包的漏洞攻击进入第五天，比特币和以太坊的价格出现下跌。截至 2026 年 8 月 3 日，这一安全事件仍未解决，并伴随着这两大加密货币的下跌。 这一事件意义重大，因为像 Coldcard 这样的硬件钱包被广泛认为是存储加密货币的最安全方式，持续的攻击会削弱用户信任。相关的市场下跌表明，安全事件可能波及整个加密货币市场的情绪。 Coldcard 是 Coinkite 自 2017 年起生产的仅支持比特币的硬件钱包，其私钥存储在专用安全芯片中。尽管现有资料未披露这一持续漏洞的具体技术细节，但硬件钱包可能通过供应链篡改、恶意固件、钓鱼攻击或物理提取等方式被攻破。
metadata.background_zh: 硬件钱包是一种物理设备，通过离线保存加密货币私钥来防范远程攻击。Coldcard 强调可验证的源代码和加密 microSD 备份等功能，因此在比特币爱好者中广受欢迎。持续多日的漏洞攻击实属罕见且令人担忧，因为这些设备的设计初衷就是尽量减小攻击面。

items.title: A super-cubic lower bound for the formula size of the permanent - www-cdn.anthropic.com
items.author: Anthropic News

metadata.title_en: Anthropic proves super-cubic lower bound for permanent's formula size
metadata.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic has released a preprint proving that the permanent requires super-cubic formula size, meaning any formula computing it has size growing faster than n^3. This is a landmark result in computational complexity theory. The result addresses a long-standing open problem about the permanent, a fundamental #P-complete function in complexity theory. The proof techniques could influence future lower-bound arguments for other explicit hard functions. The result concerns formula size, a complexity measure based on tree-like circuits rather than general directed acyclic graphs. The new theorem gives a super-cubic lower bound, significantly improving the known lower bound for the permanent's formula size.
metadata.background_en: The permanent of a matrix is a polynomial that sums the products of one entry from each row and column, similar to the determinant but with all positive signs. Computing the permanent of a 0-1 matrix is #P-complete, a result due to Valiant, so it is believed to require super-polynomial time. Formula size measures the minimum number of leaf nodes in a formula (a tree-like circuit) that computes a given function. Super-polynomial lower bounds for explicit functions like the permanent are a central open problem in complexity theory.
metadata.title_zh: Anthropic 证明积和式公式大小的超三次下界
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic 发布了一篇预印本，证明积和式需要超三次大小的公式，即任何计算它的公式大小增长快于 n^3。这是计算复杂性理论中的一项里程碑式成果。 这项成果解决了关于积和式的一个长期未决问题，而积和式是复杂度理论中一个基本的 #P 完全函数。这一证明技术可能影响未来对其它显式困难函数的下界论证。 该结果关注公式大小这一复杂度度量，它基于树状电路而非一般的有向无环图。新定理给出了超三次下界，显著提升了积和式公式大小的已知下界。
metadata.background_zh: 矩阵的积和式（permanent）是每行每列各取一个元素的乘积之和，与行列式类似，但所有项都带正号。计算 0-1 矩阵的积和式是 #P 完全问题（Valiant 定理），因此通常被认为需要超多项式时间。公式大小衡量计算一个函数的公式（树状电路）中叶节点的最少数量。为积和式这样的显式函数证明超多项式下界是复杂度理论的核心开问题。

items.title: NP-Hardness of Approximating the Closest Vector Problem within a Polynomial Factor - www-cdn.anthropic.com
items.author: Anthropic News

metadata.title_en: Anthropic Proves Approximating Closest Vector Problem Is NP-Hard
metadata.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic has published a proof showing that approximating the Closest Vector Problem (CVP) within a polynomial factor is NP-hard. This is a significant theoretical result in computational complexity. The result strengthens the security foundations of lattice-based cryptography, which underpins many post-quantum cryptographic systems. It could influence future research in cryptography and optimization algorithms. CVP is a generalization of the Shortest Vector Problem (SVP), and its conjectured intractability is central to lattice-based cryptosystems. The proof concerns worst-case hardness, showing that even approximating the problem within any polynomial factor remains NP-hard.
metadata.background_en: Lattice problems are optimization problems involving mathematical objects called lattices, and their difficulty is used to construct secure cryptographic schemes. The Closest Vector Problem asks for the lattice point closest to a given target vector. NP-hardness means that no efficient algorithm can solve the problem exactly or approximately unless P=NP, which is widely believed to be impossible. Lattice-based cryptography is a leading approach for post-quantum security because these problems appear hard even for quantum computers.
metadata.title_zh: Anthropic 证明近似最近向量问题具有 NP 难度
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic 发表了一项证明，表明在多项式因子内近似最近向量问题（CVP）是 NP 难的。这是计算复杂性领域的一项重大理论成果。 该结果加强了格基密码学的安全基础，而格基密码学支撑着许多后量子密码系统。它可能影响密码学和优化算法的未来研究。 CVP 是最短向量问题（SVP）的推广，其公认的难解性是格基密码系统的核心。该证明涉及最坏情况下的难解性，表明即使在任意多项式因子内近似该问题仍然是 NP 难的。
metadata.background_zh: 格问题是一类涉及数学对象“格”的优化问题，其难解性被用于构造安全的密码方案。最近向量问题要求找到距离给定目标向量最近的格点。NP 难意味着除非 P=NP（人们普遍认为不可能），否则不存在高效算法能精确或近似解决该问题。格基密码学是后量子安全的主要途径，因为这些问题即使对量子计算机也显得很难。

items.title: How we built a realtime system for responsive voice AI in six months
items.author: OpenAI Blog

metadata.title_en: OpenAI's GPT-Live Enables Continuous Real-Time Voice AI
metadata.detailed_summary_en: OpenAI has unveiled GPT-Live, a turnless speech model that enables continuous, low-latency voice conversations with AI. The system is described in an official blog post and represents a shift away from traditional turn-based voice interaction. This development matters because it moves voice AI toward natural, real-time conversations, potentially transforming how developers build voice applications and how users experience AI assistants. It builds on OpenAI's ongoing efforts to deliver low-latency voice AI at global scale. GPT-Live uses a turnless speech model with a low-latency architecture, enabling faster and more natural interactions. This likely leverages OpenAI's earlier work on rebuilding its WebRTC stack with a relay-transceiver design for cloud scalability.
metadata.background_en: Traditional voice AI systems are turn-based, requiring users to signal the start and end of each utterance. GPT-Live aims to eliminate this by enabling continuous speech interaction. OpenAI has previously detailed how it adapted WebRTC for low-latency voice AI at scale, which likely underpins GPT-Live's architecture.
metadata.title_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-Live 实现连续实时语音交互
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: OpenAI发布了GPT-Live，这是一种无轮次语音模型，能够实现与AI的连续、低延迟语音对话。该系统在官方博客文章中介绍，代表了从传统轮次语音交互的转变。 这一进展意义重大，因为它推动语音AI走向自然、实时的对话，可能改变开发者构建语音应用的方式以及用户体验AI助手的感受。它建立在OpenAI在全球范围内提供低延迟语音AI的持续努力之上。 GPT-Live采用无轮次语音模型和低延迟架构，从而实现更快、更自然的交互。这可能利用了OpenAI早前在重建WebRTC堆栈方面的工作，采用适用于云端可扩展性的中继-收发器设计。
metadata.background_zh: 传统的语音AI系统是轮次式的，要求用户明确指示每次话语的开始和结束。GPT-Live旨在通过实现连续语音交互来消除这一限制。OpenAI此前曾详细介绍如何改造WebRTC以支持大规模低延迟语音AI，这可能构成了GPT-Live架构的基础。

items.title: U.S.-Japan intervention revives yen carry trade fears for bitcoin
items.author: James Van Straten

metadata.title_en: U.S.-Japan Intervention Revives Yen Carry Trade Fears for Bitcoin
metadata.detailed_summary_en: The article reports that intervention by the U.S. and Japan in currency markets has revived concerns that an unwinding of the yen carry trade could spill over into risk assets, including bitcoin. This macro event creates an additional transmission channel for potential crypto sell-offs. Historically, sharp yen carry trade unwinds have triggered global risk-asset sell-offs, and bitcoin, as a high-beta risk asset, tends to suffer in such liquidity squeezes. This matters because it could drive short-term volatility and downside pressure across crypto markets even without crypto-specific news. The yen carry trade involves borrowing yen at ultra-low interest rates to invest in higher-yielding assets; intervention that strengthens the yen raises funding costs and can force rapid deleveraging. The article notes this is a macro-driven story with a clear transmission path to crypto, but it provides limited detail beyond the headline.
metadata.background_en: The yen carry trade is a popular strategy where investors borrow cheaply in yen and invest in higher-yielding assets abroad. When the yen appreciates sharply—often due to official intervention or central bank policy shifts—borrowers face larger repayment costs and may unwind positions, causing global risk assets to fall. Bitcoin, despite being called digital gold, has traded as a risk asset and is sensitive to global liquidity conditions, so carry trade unwinds can trigger sell-offs. U.S.-Japan intervention typically refers to coordinated currency-market action to support or weaken the yen.
metadata.title_zh: 美日干预重燃日元套息交易对比特币的担忧
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 文章称，美国和日本对汇市的干预重新引发了市场对日元套息交易平仓的担忧，这种平仓可能波及包括比特币在内的风险资产。这一宏观事件为加密货币抛售提供了新的传导渠道。 从历史看，日元套息交易大幅平仓曾引发全球风险资产抛售，而比特币作为高贝塔风险资产，往往在流动性收紧时承压。这意味着即便没有加密行业自身利空，该事件也可能在短期内给整个加密市场带来波动和下探压力。 日元套息交易是指以极低利率借入日元，再投资于收益率更高的资产；而推升日元的干预会抬高融资成本，可能迫使交易者快速去杠杆。文章指出这是一条传导路径清晰的宏观驱动逻辑，但除了标题之外，正文提供的细节有限。
metadata.background_zh: 日元套息交易是投资者以较低利率借入日元、再投向海外高收益资产的一种常见策略。当日元大幅升值——通常由官方干预或央行政策转向引发——借款人的还款成本上升，可能被迫平仓，进而拖累全球风险资产下跌。比特币虽然被称为“数字黄金”，但市场上它更常作为风险资产交易，对全球流动性状况敏感，因此套息交易平仓可能引发其抛售。美日干预通常指两国协调在汇市采取行动以支撑或压低日元。

items.title: BlackRock expands tokenized cash with new blockchain-based money market offerings
items.author: Ian Allison

metadata.title_en: BlackRock Expands Tokenized Cash With New Blockchain Money Market Funds
metadata.detailed_summary_en: On August 3, 2026, BlackRock announced an expansion of its tokenized cash suite with new blockchain-based money market fund offerings, building on its BUIDL fund launched in 2024 with Securitize. This move underscores continued mainstream institutional adoption of blockchain-based financial products, bridging traditional finance and crypto. It could accelerate the tokenization of real-world assets and reshape market infrastructure. The new offerings are tokenized money market funds issued on blockchain, designed to speed up settlement, enable round-the-clock trading, and improve transparency. They complement BlackRock's existing BUIDL fund and operate within regulatory frameworks for digital asset securities.
metadata.background_en: Tokenized cash brings fiat currency onto blockchain networks, offering faster settlement and lower costs compared to traditional infrastructure. Money market funds are low-risk, short-term investments; their tokenized versions issue fund shares as digital tokens recorded on a distributed ledger. The tokenized money market fund segment grew from roughly $1 billion in 2024 to over $31 billion by mid-2026, driven by asset manager launches and regulatory developments like the GENIUS Act.
metadata.title_zh: 贝莱德扩展代币化现金，推出新区块链货币市场基金
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 2026年8月3日，贝莱德宣布扩展其代币化现金产品线，推出新的基于区块链的货币市场基金，这是继2024年与Securitize合作推出BUIDL基金之后的又一举措。 此举凸显了传统金融机构对基于区块链的金融产品持续的主流采用，架起了传统金融与加密货币之间的桥梁。这可能加速现实世界资产的代币化，并重塑市场基础设施。 新产品是在区块链上发行的代币化货币市场基金，旨在加快结算、实现全天候交易并提高透明度。它们补充了贝莱德现有的BUIDL基金，并在数字资产证券的监管框架内运营。
metadata.background_zh: 代币化现金将法定货币引入区块链网络，与传统基础设施相比提供更快的结算和更低的成本。货币市场基金是低风险的短期投资工具；其代币化版本将基金份额作为数字代币发行并记录在分布式账本上。代币化货币市场基金板块从2024年约10亿美元增长到2026年年中超过310亿美元，这得益于资产管理公司的发行和GENIUS Act等监管进展。

items.title: Bitget set to exit Japan, close all remaining positions by year-end
items.author: Olivier Acuna

metadata.title_en: Bitget to Exit Japan, Close All Remaining Positions by Year-End
metadata.detailed_summary_en: Bitget, a centralized cryptocurrency exchange, has announced its exit from the Japanese market and will close all remaining positions by the end of the year. Affected users in Japan must close their positions and withdraw funds before the deadline. This development directly affects Bitget users in Japan and highlights the challenges of operating in a strictly regulated market under Japan's Payment Services Act. It also reflects the broader trend of crypto exchanges reassessing their geographic footprint amid regulatory pressure. Bitget, founded in 2018, serves over 150 million users globally, but has not disclosed the specific reasons for leaving Japan. Japan requires crypto exchanges to register under the Payment Services Act and comply with the Cabinet Office Order on Virtual Currency Exchange Service Providers, and the exit process involves closing positions and returning customer funds.
metadata.background_en: Bitget is a centralized cryptocurrency exchange established in 2018, offering trading in cryptocurrencies, tokenized stocks, ETFs, and commodities. Japan's regulatory framework, including the Payment Services Act and related orders, defines virtual currency exchange services and requires providers to be registered to operate legally. Registered exchanges must follow strict compliance rules, which can be burdensome for global platforms.
metadata.title_zh: Bitget 将退出日本，年底前清算所有剩余头寸
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 中心化加密货币交易所 Bitget 宣布退出日本市场，并将在今年年底前清算所有剩余头寸。日本的受影响用户必须在截止日期前平仓并提取资金。 这一事件直接影响 Bitget 在日本的用户，并凸显了在日本《支付服务法》严格监管下运营的挑战。它也反映了加密货币交易所在监管压力下重新评估其地理布局的广泛趋势。 Bitget 成立于 2018 年，服务全球超过 1.5 亿用户，但未披露退出日本的具体原因。日本要求加密货币交易所根据《支付服务法》注册，并遵守《虚拟货币兑换服务提供商内阁府令》，退出流程包括平仓和返还客户资金。
metadata.background_zh: Bitget 是一家成立于 2018 年的中心化加密货币交易所，提供加密货币、代币化股票、ETF 和大宗商品交易。日本的法律框架，包括《支付服务法》及相关内阁府令，定义了虚拟货币兑换服务，并要求服务提供商必须注册才能合法运营。注册交易所必须遵守严格的合规规则，这对全球平台而言可能负担较重。

items.title: Binance Will Delist ACX, HFT, PIVX, PYR, VANRY, VIC on 2026-08-17
items.author: binance_announcements

metadata.title_en: Binance to Delist Six Tokens on 2026-08-17
metadata.detailed_summary_en: Binance announced it will delist six tokens — ACX, HFT, PIVX, PYR, VANRY, and VIC — from all spot trading pairs on 2026-08-17 at 03:00 UTC. The move affects all spot trading pairs for these tokens. This is a material exchange event that affects traders holding these assets, who must close positions or withdraw tokens before the deadline. Delistings often reduce liquidity and price stability, and may signal concerns about the projects' viability or compliance. The delisting date is 2026-08-17 at 03:00 (UTC), and all spot trading pairs for the six tokens will cease. Users should manage their positions and withdrawals before this deadline.
metadata.background_en: Delisting is a process where an exchange removes a token from its trading platform, often due to low trading volume, liquidity issues, compliance concerns, or project development problems. The affected tokens include Vanar (VANRY), a carbon-neutral Layer-1 blockchain; Viction (VIC), a global Layer-1 EVM blockchain; and Vulcan Forged PYR, a web3 gaming ecosystem token. When a delisting is announced, users typically have a grace period to withdraw or trade their assets before trading ceases.
metadata.title_zh: 币安将于2026年8月17日下架六种代币
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 币安宣布将于2026年8月17日03:00（UTC）下架ACX、HFT、PIVX、PYR、VANRY和VIC这六种代币的全部现货交易对。此举影响这些代币的所有现货交易对。 这是重要的交易所事件，影响持有这些资产的交易者——他们必须在截止日期前平仓或提取代币。下架通常会导致流动性和价格稳定性下降，并可能暗示市场对这些项目的发展前景或合规性存在担忧。 下架时间为2026年8月17日03:00（UTC），届时六种代币的所有现货交易对将停止交易。用户应在该截止日期前妥善处理持仓和提现。
metadata.background_zh: 下架是指交易所将某种代币从其交易平台移除的过程，常见原因包括交易量低、流动性不足、合规问题或项目发展停滞。本次涉及的代币包括Vanar（VANRY）——一个碳中和的Layer-1区块链；Viction（VIC）——一个全球Layer-1 EVM区块链；以及Vulcan Forged PYR——一个web3游戏生态代币。当交易所宣布下架时，用户通常有一段宽限期，可以在交易停止前提取或交易其资产。
